name: VentureForGood (Youth)
confidence_note: The five-stage process, required documents and the raiSE-membership gate are VERIFIED against raise.sg (primary). The youth-track age band and quantum are from secondary grant listings; raiSE's own youth page 404s. UI must qualify the quantum. See docs/SOURCES.md.
quantum_note: Up to S$20,000 for the youth track, per published grant listings. NOT the $300,000 figure — that is the general VentureForGood track. Do not conflate these on stage.
_notes: This is the hero grant for the demo. Its remedy chain is real and every link is sourced: raiSE membership requires an ACRA-registered business (raise.sg/become-a-member), and VFG stage 3 shortlisting passes only raiSE members (raise.sg/ventureforgood-grant). A pre-incorporation founder can therefore apply but cannot be shortlisted.

That distinction is why criteria carry applies_at_stage. VFG genuinely does accept unincorporated applicants at stage 1 — saying otherwise would be wrong and a sector-literate judge would catch it. The registration requirement bites at stage 3, not stage 1.

criteria.terminal_reason: Age cannot be remedied by any action the founder can take.

criteria.requirement: Key applicant is a Singapore citizen or Permanent Resident
criteria.terminal_reason: Citizenship status is outside the scope of anything this product can advise on.

criteria.requirement: Business registered with ACRA (required in order to hold raiSE membership, not required to submit the initial application)
criteria.remedy: Register the business with ACRA via BizFile.
criteria._rationale: Not a VFG criterion in its own right — VFG accepts unincorporated applicants at stage 1. It is here because it is a hard prerequisite of raiSE membership, which IS a VFG criterion at stage 3. Encoding it as a step rather than a gate is what makes the ordered remedy chain truthful.

criteria.requirement: Must be a raiSE member — only raiSE members proceed past shortlisting
criteria.remedy: Apply for raiSE membership. $100 processing fee for Emerging and Leading tiers; raiSE states processing takes 4 to 8 weeks.

criteria.requirement: Unincorporated applicants should illustrate a partnership with a relevant Voluntary Welfare Organisation (VWO)
criteria.remedy: Approach a VWO working with your beneficiary group and document the partnership.

criteria.requirement: …and/or validation with the intended beneficiary group
criteria.remedy: Document engagements with your intended beneficiaries, or with an SSA or sector expert who can vouch for the need.
criteria._rationale: blocking is FALSE for this group on purpose. raiSE's published wording is 'should illustrate' and 'encouraged', not 'must'. Encoding a soft expectation as a hard gate would tell a founder they are blocked when they are not — and we would deserve to be caught on it. It surfaces as strong advice, not a wall.

warnings.message: raiSE's own published timeline for the five VentureForGood stages runs roughly 4 to 6 months before any funds are disbursed, and raiSE membership must be in place before shortlisting. Plan cash needs accordingly.
